description: Which model tier should serve a request: the smallest that answers it correctly. State: {request, system, turns, tools, prompt_tokens, images}.

tier.instructions: What is the smallest model tier that would answer this request correctly?

criteria.small: a small fast model: lookup, formatting, extraction, short factual answers
criteria.medium: a mid-size model: ordinary code edits, summaries, one or two reasoning steps
criteria.large: a large model: multi-step reasoning, non-trivial code, long context
criteria.frontier: the strongest model: hard proofs, research-grade problems, long plans under ambiguity

long_context.instructions: Does answering require reading a long document, many files or a long history?

private_model_required.instructions: Must the request stay on a private, self-hosted model because of the data it involves?
